metadata.title: Surrealist Pop Collage with Muscle Car and Pin-up

retrievalProfile.description: A complex, layered collage blending 1970s muscle car culture with surrealist mechanical elements and pin-up illustration using airbrushed gradients.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic composition featuring a green muscle car angled diagonally, overlaid with mechanical gear-like shapes, a pin-up figure in a contorted pose, and large geometric stars, all set against a background of abstract geometric patterns and soft airbrushed gradients.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal tension between the car and the pin-up figure
Juxtaposition of organic human forms with hard-edged mechanical gears
Layering of flat geometric shapes (stars, L-frame) over rendered 3D objects
Contrast between the saturated green of the car and the muted terracotta border
coreInvariants: Airbrushed gradient shading on all 3D-rendered elements
Diagonal orientation of the primary subject (car)
Presence of large, flat white geometric stars in the foreground

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The muscle car dominates the lower right quadrant at a steep diagonal; the pin-up figure occupies the upper left, creating a counter-balance.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white stars in the lower center act as the primary visual anchor, breaking the depth of the car.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal line of the car upward to the mechanical gears, then circles back through the pin-up's arm toward the central L-shaped frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Negative space is filled with a pale, geometric pattern, preventing any true 'empty' areas and maintaining high visual density.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted terracotta border and pale yellow/green background patterns.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep forest green and black of the muscle car.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white for the stars and L-frame; vibrant cyan and magenta for the thin circular lines.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white foreground elements and the dark car body; saturation is concentrated in the car and the thin neon-like rings.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, slanted sans-serif and decorative outlined numerals.
letterConstructionRules: Italicized orientation to match the car's perspective
characterSpecificRedesigns: Numerals are stylized with internal parallel lines to suggest speed and automotive decals.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative automotive face paired with small, clean sans-serif for technical details.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the 70s automotive aesthetic and wide stance.
Provides the necessary geometric, technical feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a surreal collage featuring a green 1970s muscle car at a diagonal angle, a pin-up girl in a blue top, and floating grey mechanical gears against a pale geometric background with a terracotta border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add white outlined numerals and small sans-serif text onto the car hood following the perspective of the vehicle; place two large white stars in the foreground.

verificationChecks: Is the car angled at a steep diagonal?
Are the stars flat white without shading?
Does the text follow the perspective of the car hood?
Is the border a consistent terracotta color?

postGenerationChecks: Check for smooth color transitions in the airbrushing
Ensure the stars are perfectly geometric and opaque
Verify the perspective of the car matches the text placement
Confirm the terracotta border frames the entire composition
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject: Automotive/Mechanical] with [Subject: Human Figure] using [Style: Airbrushed Surrealism] and [Graphic Element: Flat Geometric Overlays] within a [Frame: Solid Color Border].
